title: dedicated-autoscaler-burst-util-reporting-improvements-and-throughput-smoothing
author: Asha Kapoor
description: Motivation: production fleets have observed noisy burst utilization metrics and occasional transient throttle spikes when autoscaler token-buckets refill rapidly. This makes it hard for SREs and customers to interpret short-lived bursts vs sustained load. This PR refactors the dedicated autoscaler reporting pipeline to: 1) smooth burst-utilization metrics with an exponential moving average (configurable per-fleet), 2) emit new throughput_guarantee signal and a derived burst_capacity_remaining gauge, and 3) add dashboard-friendly labels (region, capacity_tier) to utilization metrics. Summary of changes: - Introduces a smoothing window parameter (default 30s EWMA) applied at the aggregator before persisting to timeseries DB. - Adds throughput_guarantee metric that encodes the current committed TPS for a fleet, computed from reserved_capacity and per-instance throughput profile. - Derives burst_capacity_remaining as an integer token count for dashboards and alert rules. - Updates autoscaler decision logs to include both raw and smoothed utilization to aid postmortems. - Adds unit and integration tests covering EWMA edge cases (cold start, sudden drop, sustained step increase) and end-to-end reporting assertions against the local timeseries test harness. Backwards compatibility: metric names are additive; raw metrics (util_raw) are still emitted for customers who consume high-frequency streams. Rollout plan: staged rollout to non-critical fleets for 48h canary (flagged by feature_gate autoscaler_reporting_v2) then progressive enablement with 10%, 50%, 100% using rollout controller; rollback is a toggle in feature flags. Checklist: - [x] design doc linked (ENG-5421) - [x] unit tests added - [x] integration test harness updated - [x] docs/console dashboard snippet updated - [x] runbook / alert thresholds proposed in release notes - [x] add feature flag gating for canary

release_notes:
- Improve dedicated autoscaler utilization reporting by smoothing burst utilization (EWMA) to reduce noise and false alerts.
- Emit throughput_guarantee and burst_capacity_remaining metrics for clearer capacity visibility.
- Add per-fleet smoothing window override.
- Dashboard updates and runbook for tuning alert thresholds.
notes_for_ops: Feature gated under autoscaler_reporting_v2. Default smoothing window 30s; override via fleet metadata key 'reporting.ewma_window_s'. Alert rules should be reviewed: suggested threshold for sustained util_smoothed > 0.9 for 5m to trigger scale-up. If regressions seen, flip the feature flag and redeploy ingest pipeline to fallback config.
